messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: elevated 5xx rate detected for route /v1/generate on frontdoor-lb-prod. Alert: 5xx_rate > 5% for 5m. paging: oncall-sre

pagerduty: Paging alice (SRE) — high priority incident. Escalation: immediate on-call.

alice (SRE): I got the page, looking now. Any customer-facing alerts? Maria, FYI.

maria (ProdOps): Not yet public, but support is seeing error reports. Estimating ~3–6% user requests failing - some timeouts and 502/504s.

alice (SRE): First check: cluster health and LB metrics. devon can you share recent LB config change diffs?

devon (Infra): No intentional LB push in last 6 hours. There was an automated weight rebalance at 02:12 UTC by autoscaler-svc. Pushing the diff now.

devon (Infra): ```diff
--- /etc/lb/weights/previous
+++ /etc/lb/weights/current
@@
- service-api-shard-3: 0.12
+ service-api-shard-3: 0.40
- service-api-shard-7: 0.40
+ service-api-shard-7: 0.10
```

samir (Runtime): That weight shift is suspicious. Shard-3 has older model variants and a different Envoy cluster config; we've seen higher 5xx under load on that shard before.

alice (SRE): Pulling Envoy stats from shard-3. Running: `curl -s http://envoy-shard-3:9901/stats | egrep "upstream_rq_5xx|cluster.service-api-shard-3"`

alice (SRE): Output snippet: ```
cluster.service-api-shard-3.upstream_rq_5xx: 124
cluster.service-api-shard-3.upstream_rq_4xx: 5
cluster.service-api-shard-3.upstream_cx_connect_fail: 8
cluster.service-api-shard-3.circuit_breakers.default.cx_overflow: 0
cluster.service-api-shard-3.outlier_detection.ejections: 7
```

alice (SRE): 5xxs and outlier ejections increasing. Looks like envoy is ejecting hosts in that cluster which can cascade -> higher errors as traffic shifts.

kevin (SRE): Can we confirm request samples? dev logs or nginx proxies in front of shard-3?

samir (Runtime): Grabbed a sample from the proxy: ```
[2026-03-15T02:34:12Z] "POST /v1/generate" 502 0.003s "upstream reset" shard=service-api-shard-3
[2026-03-15T02:34:13Z] "POST /v1/generate" 504 1.200s "upstream timeout" shard=service-api-shard-3
```

alice (SRE): Hypothesis: autoscaler reweighted traffic to shard-3, which has a mismatch in retry/circuit-breaker config or an overloaded pool -> Envoy ejects, causing 5xx spike. Immediate mitigation options: 1) revert weight change (fast), 2) change LB weights to shift traffic off shard-3, 3) disable retries to avoid retry amplification, 4) increase circuit breaker thresholds temporarily.

maria (ProdOps): We need something fast that doesn't risk more customer impact. Reverting weight or shifting traffic away sounds safest.

devon (Infra): I can roll back the weight change. Rolling now: `lbctl apply --file rollback-3509876543.yaml`

devon (Infra): Rollback applied. New weights: shard-3 -> 0.10, shard-7 -> 0.45.

alice (SRE): Monitoring metrics... dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/5xx?route=/v1/generate (link)

alice (SRE): Within 30s we see drop in 5xx rate from 5.4% -> 1.1%. Outlier ejections on shard-3 dropping.

kevin (SRE): Nice. Any lasting backlog or ongoing retries in-flight? Let's disable retries at Envoy for /v1/generate just in case. Samir?

samir (Runtime): We can flip the route-level retry policy to 0 retries. Pushing small patch to envoy route config now. `kubectl -n platform exec envoy-config-pusher -- ./pusher --route /v1/generate --retries 0`

samir (Runtime): Patch applied, route retries = 0.

alice (SRE): Observing latency histograms — p50/p95 stable. 5xx rate back to baseline ~0.3% in last 2m.

maria (ProdOps): Support: please update customers in the next 30m. I will coordinate an initial status update: brief, what happened, mitigation, impact.

devon (Infra): Note: autoscaler job had a bad predicate causing overweight to older shard variants. I've paused autoscaler for frontdoor-lb-prod and filed PR to add extra checks (link: https://git.internal/redwood/autoscaler/pull/742).

alice (SRE): Action items captured: (1) postmortem draft, (2) autoscaler fix + safety gates, (3) add metric alert for sudden weight delta > 20% per 5m, (4) run chaos test on shard ejection behavior. Assign owners: devon -> autoscaler fix; samir -> add test for retry amplification; kevin -> postmortem lead; alice -> monitor and write remediation timeline.

kevin (SRE): I'll start the postmortem doc, link in #postmortems once initial timeline is ready.

maria (ProdOps): Customer impact summary for status: ~3–6% of requests to /v1/generate experienced 502/504 over a 12m window; mitigation (weight rollback + retries disabled) cut errors to baseline within 3 minutes of rollback. No data loss. Customers with high volume jobs may have had spikes and should retry.

alice (SRE): On-call handoff: I will stay through the recovery window for 30 minutes. If metrics are green at 03:05 UTC, I'll handoff to kevin for follow-up.

kevin (SRE): Acknowledged. I'll take over at 03:05 UTC.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 5xx error rate returned to baseline. Root cause: autoscaler weight rebalance pushed disproportionate traffic to an older shard with known instability; Envoy outlier ejections amplified failures.

alice (SRE): Final note: avoid rolling weight shifts during peak traffic windows; add preflight for autoscaler. Will include recommended config guardrails in the postmortem.

maria (ProdOps): Will draft the customer-facing note and share for review.

kevin (SRE): closing thread after postmortem link added. Thanks all for quick response :thumbsup:

-- end thread --
